paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy of a model over the course of training, comparing the accuracy of the training and validation sets. The x-axis, labeled “Epoch,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels spaced every 5 epochs. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, also uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 35% to 95%, with tick labels spaced approximately every 5 percentage points. A blue solid line represents the training accuracy, starting at approximately 45% at Epoch 0 and reaching a peak of approximately 92% at Epoch 20.  A green dashed line represents the validation accuracy, beginning near 60% at Epoch 0 and reaching a maximum of approximately 80% at Epoch 15, subsequently declining to approximately 75% at Epoch 30.
